summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`, unpacks it, marks the binary executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunBinaryPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')],...)` against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with `_0xNNNN`-style mangled identifiers, a rotating numeric string-array (`n7gIxM=[...]`), a `WV8StW` string-array shifter, and a `hc1jfK9` character-table decoder — no readable strings, no source map. Both the loader and the payload use obfuscator.io-style renaming and property-lookup indirection. The package's stated purpose is a React/IoC 'communication registry' library; downloading an alternate JavaScript runtime and running an obfuscated payload under it at install is unrelated to that purpose and bypasses Node-based inspection. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` npm scope with a description matching an internal-sounding product and depends on other `@servicetitan/*` packages, consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting ServiceTitan's private registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
